# 4 bedroom detached house for sale

> SUMMARY A spacious four bedroom detached family home with amazing potential to add personalisation. The property benefits from a double garage, driveway and enclosed rear garden. This property is located in a popular residential area of Worcester with great access to the M5 motorway and local amenities.
